household_message.text: Out at work from 8:30 till 5 today. Dishwasher done before we're home please.

message_to_household: The dishwasher will run from 09:30 to 10:30, using solar power up to 2.8 kW and then grid electricity at 0.327 EUR/kWh, finishing well before 17:00. The car will charge to 80% as usual, ready by 07:30. The heat pump will supply 27 kWh of electricity. This plan saves 0.15 EUR compared to starting now and values solar energy at the feed‑in price of 0.123 EUR/kWh.
